reviews.t: An experience that is almost too good to be true
reviews.x: Since initial purchase I was kept informed by the seller as to the status of the purchased product, which my wife liked as she was anxious to try the new kid on the block. The product package looks great and much richer than in the images, a very inviting product packaging. Inside, the thick, creamy formula looks rich and prescription-like. Nothing to complain about and given the obvious thought that has gone into the Miracalis Anti-Aging Moisturizer Cream, Daily Skin Care Treatment... we are su

I purchased this for my mom. She was a little concerned at first that I gave her an anti aging wrinkly cream, but after she used it for a while the results spoke for themselves. The product works as described, and my mom continues to talk about how she notices a difference day in and out. Both of us are pleased with the results!

If you ever read my blog you hear me say this constantly... "there are products I like then there are products I love". Right? Seriously, right now sitting on your vanity are products you love and there are products you do not know what to do with. Those products that simply didn't work  as you imagined, you didn't like the color pay off, didn't last, where expensive but you didn't like so what do you do with them? Right?   Well here is a product I like.   Miracalis Anti-Aging Moisturize
Product looks great. Thick, creamy texture. Should last a good while. Bought it for my girlfriend who was looking for a cream like this and says she loves it so far. She's happy so I'm happy.

My wife was looking at anti-aging creams but couldn't find any that she really liked or made any noticeable difference to her skin. I saw this cream on Amazon and told her she should give it a try since it had great reviews and seemed to be a good price. She's been happy with the purchase ever since and within weeks her skin is noticeably softer and the small amount of wrinkles she had are fading away. Will definitely be ordering more.

I started noticing tiny lines around my mouth and eyes and some spots on my face.  I still wash my face with MK timewise, however I now use this as my moisturizer. Pretty certain this caused me to break out / have a reaction. I NEVER have skin break outs, however I noticed after using this continually that my skin was breaking after almost every application. I finished the product hoping it would clear up / balance out but unfortunately it didnt. I have lots of little clogged pores on my forehead which I never had before using this product. I will not be ordering again... Also saw no noticeable improvement in skin tone with this product.

I purchased this brand of cream for my girlfriend to try out based on the great reviews. She was pleasantly surprised as to the quality and texture, especially because she has very sensitive skin. She has tried a few other creams and using this one there is a notable difference. This seller also goes above and beyond attaching a nice skin care guide, I will definitely be ordering more for her!

I love this cream. I am really surprised how this cream helps my face to go from looking dry to looking fresh and alive. It is a nice hydration cream. It is not greasy, smells GREAT and does a fantastic job. It is an excellent moisturizer that wears very well under my liquid foundation. It is also excellent for night time. I have dry pealy skin and this cream helped so much. I put it on mornings before applying my makeup, and it helped my makeup go on smoothly without showing any dryness or peels of my skin! I noticed my skin feeling a bit tighter and I saw less fine lines near my eyes. My only issue with the cream I have had is I started to get a few ac

This is one fantastic face and neck cream and I've tried dozens, if not hundreds. Smooths and firms with out a harsh chemical peel feeling or weird over-tightening like you get with a lot of the "lift" products.  Nice fresh mild smell, not over fragranced. Silky texture, not greasy or watery.  (Did I mentioned I've tried dozens?)  Getting ready to reorder it and the serum (which I haven't tried) but I HIGHLY recommend the cream. Excellent product and great value.

I have very sensitive skin, so i was apprehensive about trying this out, but did it anyway, and IT IS GREAT!!! If you have sensitive skin, you don't need to worry! This will be ok! I use this along with Vitamin C serum, and eye cream, and I have seen a difference in my wrinkles around my eyes. Unless I have a huge smile on my face, the crows feet are disappearing!!! And that is wonderful for me!! I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review.

I am constantly looking for an anti aging face cream with good ingredients. When I opened the box for this cream, I really liked that there is no smell! I do not like smells on my face all day and also putting something that smells on my face cannot be very healthy for my skin. This cream goes on smooth and stays on. I happened to see a discount code for this cream and ordered it immediately. I could definitely recommend this to others.

reviews.t: It is great that it is not scented
reviews.x: I wanted to use this cream for a while, before writing my review. It is great that it is not scented. I am using it as a moisturizer on my dry skin. It has been working great so far. I apply it in the morning and in the evening before bed. I have had no breakouts yet, and I have sensitive skin. It makes my skin feel smooth. Overall, it is a great moisturizer. I would highly recommend the product.

I like this moisturizer and think that if you use it everyday you see firmer skin over time. My problem is that I tend to use products rather sporadically. A little goes a long way. Great for the neck. Compared to other moisturizers on the market, I think you get great value for your money.

reviews.t: lighten or do anything for wrinkles and or fine lines. It does not do what it says ...
reviews.x: This item did not remove, lighten or do anything for wrinkles and or fine lines. It does not do what it says it will. It felt fine as a facial cream, not too much smell to it, just a bit. I would buy it again IF it removed even one fine line. It did absolutely nothing for wrinkles!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the cream works as described and produces noticeable improvements in skin, with several buying it for a wife, girlfriend, or mother who was happy with the results.
Reviewers frequently praise the thick, creamy texture and quality of the product and its packaging.
A few reviewers report skin reactions such as breakouts, clogged pores, or irritation after using the cream.
Some reviewers mention the jar arrived with a cracked or broken cap, though at least one notes the seller quickly replaced it.
A few reviewers describe the product as merely okay or not delivering the results they hoped for.
